subject: Aegis - CAIQ crosswalk, evidence routing and SLA carve-outs
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aegis-fin.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aegis-fin.com, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@aegis-fin.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: CAIQ + evidence lane

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving toward an internal security review and procurement needs a CAIQ crosswalk and a minimal set of artifacts we can hand to our auditors. Two asks: 1) can you provide a filled CAIQ crosswalk (mapping your claims to CSA controls) and 2) give a clear list of 3-4 runtime proofs (log samples, keystore rotation proofs, and any isolation diagrams) we can attach to the procurement packet?

Also — we have an SLA carve-out question: our legal team wants to know if Redwood can accept a 99.5% monthly uptime target for a dedicated deployment in region us-east-1; if not, could you identify what controls would need additional monitoring to justify an exception?

We're on a tight procurement cadence (target: terms signed by 2027-07-15). Can you confirm an ETA and who on your side will own the evidence handoff?

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of IT Risk
Aegis Financial

--
Attachment: none in original mail
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aegis-fin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ + evidence lane

Liam — thanks, and glad the demo was useful.

Short answers up front: we can deliver a completed CAIQ crosswalk and a compact evidence bundle (logs + rotation artifacts + network isolation diagram) within 5 business days; I'll need to coordinate a small artifact pull and a short attestation from our infra leads. On SLA: our standard Dedicated SLA today is 99.9% for committed pools; 99.5% is below our published tier but we can discuss a temporary carve-out tied to additional monitoring (extra telemetry retention + a runbook for warm-fallback routing) — I'll surface which CSA control IDs would be impacted.

I'll own the CAIQ mapping, but I'll loop in Kimberly (control owners/evidence curator) and Priyom (telemetry/retention) to produce the attachment set and the SLA rationale.

Action items from our side:
- Kimberly: assemble crosswalk spreadsheet + artifacts (redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx, runtime-telemetry-sample.log, sla-exception-request.pdf)
- Priyom: pull sample logs and write the monitoring augmentation note
- Karhtik (me): consolidate and deliver to Liam; provide list of controls impacted by SLA carve-out

Can you confirm whether Aegis needs any artifacts redacted or if full runtime logs (with token ids redacted) are acceptable? If redaction is required, that adds 1 day to the ETA.

Thanks — I'll aim for a Friday deliverable if no redaction is needed.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference

--

Karthik / Priyom — attaching the first-pass artifacts.

Attachment stubs included:
- redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (sheet1: control mapping; sheet2: narrative justifications; sheet3: outstanding asks)
- runtime-telemetry-sample.log (1-hour sample, user identifiers redacted)
- sla-exception-request.pdf (short memo outlining extra monitoring and control IDs)
- network-isolation-diagram.svg (inline diagram referenced in the crosswalk)

Notes:
- I mapped the CAIQ control IDs that intersect with our SLA surface: CCM-OP-01 (Availability monitoring), CCM-IS-03 (Incident routing) and CCM-CR-02 (Change management for failover). Those are called out in the sla-exception-request.pdf.
- Priyom: please confirm the exact retention windows we can offer for telemetry (standard: 30 days hot, 90 days cold) and whether we can add a 90-day hot retention for the carve-out.
- Liam: if Aegis wants redacted logs removed rather than redaction, call that out — removal will delay by 2 days.

I'll wait for your sign-off and then I'll upload the bundle to the Aegis Drive folder and share the DocuSign envelope (we use the envelope to capture a brief attestation about evidence receipt).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
